cohort: The study included mothers diagnosed with EP-FGR (singleton, EFW <3rd percentile, <600g, 20+0 - 26+6 weeks of gestation) and their live-born infants, with a UK subgroup of EP-FGR infants (<36 weeks) sex-matched and gestation-matched to appropriate for age (AGA) preterm infants (EFW 25th-75th percentile).
finding: EP-FGR was associated with increased risks of neonatal morbidity, including BPD, surgical NEC, ROP treatment, and longer neonatal stays, compared with AGA preterm infants, with mortality also potentially higher.
country: UK, Germany, Spain, Sweden (UK for subgroup analysis)
followup_time: Neonatal period (outcomes mentioned are immediate postnatal and 'neonatal stays')
birth_weight: Estimated fetal weight (EFW) <3rd percentile, <600g for EP-FGR; EFW 25th-75th percentile for AGA controls.
gest_age: 20+0 - 26+6 weeks of gestation for EP-FGR diagnosis; mean gestational age at birth 31.4 weeks for EP-FGR infants; <36 weeks for UK preterm infants.
